description: This file contains shell script code for configuring and managing WireGuard VPN interfaces on OpenWrt, including setup, key management, peer configuration, and teardown.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the WireGuard protocol configuration with default parameters such as private key, listen port, mtu, fwmark, and addresses.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Ensures that a private key exists for the specified configuration, generating and saving one if necessary.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up a WireGuard interface, loads configuration, generates keys if needed, builds the WireGuard configuration, applies it, and assigns IP addresses and prefixes.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_renew
methods.description: Reinitializes the WireGuard interface configuration by calling the setup function.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the WireGuard interface by deleting the network device.
